rows.label: tlk79000005_01_msg0001
rows.name:
In every age, there are sly old foxes
waiting to stab someone in the back.

rows.label: tlk79000005_01_msg0002
rows.name:
I'm not referring to anyone in
particular, you understand.

rows.label: tlk79000005_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I've simply seen and heard many such
stories. Please take it as a general
observation.
